title: Black Butler
description: Black Butler Season 4: Public School ArcButler Sebastian Michaelis works with his 13-year-old master, the earl Ciel Phantomhive, to do the dirty work of “the Queen’s guard dog” in nineteenth century England’s gritty underworld.One day, Ciel receives a letter from Queen Victoria telling him that several students at Weston College, one of England’s top public schools, have seemingly disappeared… including a relative of hers named Derrick. And so, Sebastian and Ciel infiltrate Weston College to get the bottom of the matter. What truly happened to these students?

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ciel begins attending England’s prestigious Weston College. This insular school values tradition, is bound by strict discipline, and is ruled by the prefects of its four boarding houses, collectively known as "P4".

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ciel builds his reputation within the school in order to get close to the P4. His success grants him the opportunity to participate in an exclusive gathering reserved only for prefects and their drudges. However, this meeting doesn't go as expected.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ciel decides to pay back Maurice Cole for his underhanded trick. Since Maurice lives in a different boarding house, he arranges a special exemption for an acquaintance to be admitted to Weston so that he can monitor Maurice.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ciel wins the P4's trust, but he still can't find a chance to get close to the Head Master. And so he brings up the subject of Derrick Arden with the P4 and their drudges. When he does, the expressions on the prefects' faces change...

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ciel hears some promising information: the ever-busy Head Master will be attending Weston's traditional cricket tournament, and evidently the student who exhibits the most sportsmanlike behaviour will be invited to the Head Master's "midnight tea party."

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Ciel is chosen to play cricket, but the boys of Sapphire Owl House are the perennial wooden spooners. They've had just one victory in the history of the tournament. Ciel resolves to wrest another victory for his House—without any miracles.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Ciel and the rest of Sapphire Owl House have won their way into the deciding match. As the cricketers exercise their talents to the fullest, Sebastian pursues the Head Master, who has appeared at last.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: At the boat parade that caps off the cricket tournament, Ciel vows once again to learn the truth and present it to Queen Victoria.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: His efforts in the cricket tournament having succeeded, Ciel now has an invitation to a tea party sponsored by Weston College's absolute monarch: the Head Master.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The truth behind the disappearances of Derrick Arden and the others comes to light. What's more, Ciel discovers that a former Phantomhive ally has been involved all along.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 4 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: His duty as the Queen's guard dog complete, Ciel and his servants take a trip to London to inspect new Funtom Company goods. Later, Sebastian is reunited with someone unexpected.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Sebastian and Ciel begin investigating a series of suspicious deaths in Germany at the Queen's request.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Wolfram installs the group in the Castle. Ciel and Sullivan sit down to dine, only to receive shocking news.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Sebastian and Ciel pay a price for entering the Werewolves' Forest. Sullivan agrees to help, on one condition.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Sebastian starts serving Sullivan as her butler. Meanwhile, Ciel seems to have become a different person.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: While Sebastian and Snake are off investigating the Emerald Castle behind Wolfram's back, a werewolf attacks.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Sebastian intuits that they are out of time and sternly confronts Ciel.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Sullivan finally completes the Ultimate Spell.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After learning everything there is to know about the mystery, Ciel presses Sullivan to come to a decision.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The villagers madly pursue Sullivan, resulting in a fierce battle between them and the Phantomhive servants.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Ciel is saved by Diederich. But Wolfsschlucht is home to another threat beyond the werewolves and curses...

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: After escaping death, Sebastian and the others reunite, but they're only afforded a brief moment of relief.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Sebastian and the others manage to escape the Werewolves' Forest. Diederich tells Ciel something surprising.

episodes_data.title: Black Butler Season 5 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The household returns to England, where their final task is to present Sullivan to the Queen.
